question: Combustion of one methane gas molecule gives _______ carbon dioxide and _______ water molecules, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is **1: ****2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Methane gas**

 
 
• **​**Methane, which has the chemical formula CH₄, is the simplest of the **saturated hydrocarbons**. The simplest alkane is composed of one carbon atom and four hydrogen atoms.
 
• **Atmospheric methane**, which can be found both** below the seafloor and above ground**, is produced when natural methane reaches the surface of the atmosphere.
 
• It has **no color, has no smell, or smells like sweet oil**. It is a gas that is not harmful but can burn. It is a molecule with four equivalent C-H bonds and a tetrahedral shape.
 
• **Anaerobes** in the colon make it. In** 1776**, Italian physicist **Alessandro Volta** was the first to scientifically identify methane.
 
 
 
• **Combustion of methane gas** 
 
 
• ​The term "combustible" refers to the possibility of** burning methane**. Methane and oxygen undergo a chemical reaction in this process.
 
• A lot of** energy**, water (H2O), and carbon dioxide (CO2) are the byproducts of this reaction.
 
• To represent the combustion of methane, chemists would write:

 **CH₄[g] + 2 O₂[g] -> CO₂[g] + 2 H₂O[l] + 891 kJ​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CH₄ Uses (Methane)**

 
 
• It is used as a** fuel** in automobiles, ovens, and water heaters.
 
• It is also used to **generate electricity.**
 
• It is used as refined liquid **rocket fuel.**
 
• It is used in industries as an antifreeze ingredient.
 
• It is a common **fertilizer ingredient.**
 
• It is used to sanitize products.
 
• It is used in **gas-fired power stations.**
 
• It is used in gas cookers.
 
• It is used to test **gas appliances.**
